items.name: button-bubble

items.name: button-elastic

items.name: button-flip

items.name: button-magnetic

items.name: button-shift

items.name: button-stagger

items.name: column-wave-background

items.name: smooth-cursor-line
items.title: SmoothCursorLine
items.description: Canvas ribbon that trails the cursor across the viewport, fading along its length. Takes a CSS custom property name so it follows the theme; hidden below 992px.

items.name: floating-gradient-background
items.title: FloatingGradientBackground
items.description: Slow-drifting gradient orbs on independent orbits.

css.@keyframes floating-move-horizontal: 0% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-10%); } 50% { transform: translateX(50%) translateY(10%); } 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-10%); }
css.@keyframes floating-move-in-circle: 0% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(180deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
css.@keyframes floating-move-vertical: 0% { transform: translateY(-50%); } 50% { transform: translateY(50%); } 100% { transform: translateY(-50%); }

items.name: navbar-floating-logo

items.name: navbar-fullscreen-static
items.title: NavbarFullscreenStatic

items.name: navbar-inline

items.name: navbar-links-static
items.title: NavbarLinksStatic
items.description: Absolute bar over a dark hero: logo and inline links in light text, collapsing to a menu button with an animated panel on mobile.

items.name: navbar-store
items.title: NavbarStore
items.description: Fixed store navbar: an optional thin announcement strip whose messages scroll in an endless marquee, above a white bar with the wordmark on the left, links centred with an underline that draws in on hover, and a text link plus account, wishlist and bag icons on the right. On mobile the links and text link collapse into a menu button with an animated panel.

items.name: loader-swirl
items.title: LoaderSwirl
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a thick brush-stroke swirl in the foreground color covers the screen, then unwinds to reveal the page. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: appear-on-scroll
items.title: AppearOnScroll
items.description: Wrapper that reveals its children once when scrolled into view. Same three variants as WordByWordReveal (slide-up, fade-blur, fade), plus rotate-scale, which lifts the content in from a slight tilt and smaller scale on a soft overshoot-free ease; with an optional delay for staggering.

items.name: selector-button
items.title: SelectorButton
items.description: Segmented control with an indicator that slides and resizes to the active option.

items.name: word-by-word-reveal
items.title: WordByWordReveal
items.description: Reveals a heading word by word on scroll into view. Three variants: slide-up, fade-blur, fade. Set immediate to play on mount instead, for above-the-fold copy.

items.name: text-color-fill-on-scroll
items.title: TextColorFillOnScroll
items.description: Brightens a heading word by word as the block travels through the viewport. Optional blur makes each word also sharpen from blurred as it fills; offset sets the scroll range (useful when the heading is pinned).
items.props: text, tag?, dimmed?, blur?, offset?, className?

items.name: tilted-card-slideshow
items.title: TiltedCardSlideshow
items.description: Auto-advancing carousel whose side slides sit back in 3D behind a blur. Renders one slot per item, up to five.

items.name: scroll-paced-video
items.title: ScrollPacedVideo
items.description: Scrubs a video's playback with scroll position inside a sticky viewport. Holds a spinner until the video can play through, then fades any overlay children in.

items.name: theme-tokens

items.description: Baseline color and radius tokens these components read. Skip this if the project already has shadcn tokens defined — the components use the same names.

items.name: spinning-photo-ring

items.name: photo-tunnel-on-scroll

items.name: warping-video-player
items.title: WarpingVideoPlayer
items.description: A video block that grows from the centre as you scroll, warping like cloth before settling into a full rounded frame, with a play button, pause toggle and draggable progress bar.

items.name: swipe-card-deck

items.description: A stack of tilted cards where the front card slides out to the side and tucks behind the pile as the next one comes forward, with arrows and swipe.

items.name: dissolving-dot-image
items.title: DissolvingDotImage
items.description: An image made of thousands of fine dots that dissolve into loose, drifting grains around the cursor and settle back, flying together into the picture when it scrolls into view.

items.name: morphing-particle-words
items.title: MorphingParticleWords
items.description: A word made of thousands of particles that fly apart and re-form into the next word, scattering away from the cursor as you move over it.

items.name: velocity-text-rows
items.title: VelocityTextRows
items.description: Rows of giant text that loop sideways in opposite directions, speeding up, reversing and leaning with your scroll.

items.name: throwable-tag-pile
items.title: ThrowableTagPile
items.description: Tags drop in with gravity and settle into a pile you can grab, toss and knock around.

items.name: bending-line-grid
items.title: BendingLineGrid
items.description: A grid of thin lines that bends toward the cursor like a gravity well, glowing where it's pulled, behind your content.

items.name: confetti-burst
items.title: ConfettiBurst
items.description: Wraps any element and bursts theme-coloured confetti from it on click, hover or when it scrolls into view.

items.name: spreading-card-stack
items.title: SpreadingCardStack
items.description: A messy stack of cards that fans out into a neat grid as it scrolls into view, and stacks back up when you scroll back.

items.name: lanyard-badge
items.title: LanyardBadge
items.description: An event-pass style badge hanging from a strap that swings on its own, can be grabbed and thrown around, and settles back with a natural sway.
items.props: imageSrc?, title?, description?, label?, tag?, code?, strapText?, children?, className?

items.name: throwable-photo-stack
items.title: ThrowablePhotoStack
items.description: A messy pile of polaroid photos you can grab, lift, throw and spin across the table, each landing with a soft shadow.

items.name: slide-over-sections
items.title: SlideOverSections
items.description: Stacks two sections on scroll: the under section scrolls until its bottom reaches the bottom of the screen, then pins while the over section slides up across it, and the pinned one shrinks slightly and darkens (shrink and shade set how much) as it is covered, so even same-colored sections read as layers. Tall under sections are shown in full before they pin.
items.props: under, over, shrink?, shade?, className?, overClassName?

items.name: gradient-word-reveal
items.title: GradientWordReveal
items.description: Word-by-word text reveal like WordByWordReveal (slide-up, fade-blur or fade, staggered as it scrolls into view), with the text painted in one continuous left-to-right gradient from the foreground colour into the same colour at 45% opacity, echoing a two-tone title. Each word carries its own slice of a gradient sized to the whole text block, so the gradient stays seamless across words and lines and every word stays visible while it animates.

items.name: stagger-text
items.title: StaggerText
items.description: The ButtonStagger hover label on its own, to drop inside any existing link or button: on hover of that link or button (desktop), each letter slides up in quick succession to reveal a copy of itself from below.

items.name: loader-progress
items.title: LoaderProgress
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: an avatar (imageSrc) and a name (title) that fills in left to right sit above a progress bar, then the panel wipes up to reveal the page. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-spinner
items.title: LoaderSpinner
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a shape (imageSrc, e.g. an SVG star, used as a mask in the theme's background color) fades in once loaded and spins on a foreground-colored screen, then shrinks away and the loader fades out. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-pixel-wipe
items.title: LoaderPixelWipe
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a grid of square pixels clears line by line across the screen (top to bottom on portrait), each line's pixels fading out in random order. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-shutter
items.title: LoaderShutter
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: ten horizontal shutters collapse upward one after another from the bottom, revealing the page. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-cube
items.title: LoaderCube
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: the cover is the face of a 3D cube that pushes back and rotates away, revealing the page behind it. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-curve
items.title: LoaderCurve
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: the cover pulls up off the screen while its bottom edge bows into an arc. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-columns
items.title: LoaderColumns
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: five columns with hairline dividers slide down off the screen one after another. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-pixels
items.title: LoaderPixels
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a responsive grid of square pixels (8 to 16 columns by screen size) dissolves in random order. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-words
items.title: LoaderWords
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a dot and a word rise in, the word cycles through a list of greetings (words), then everything lifts away. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-counter
items.title: LoaderCounter
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a centered NumberFlow counter rolls from 00 to 100 while a thin bar fills along the top, then the cover pulls up with an arced edge. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-percent
items.title: LoaderPercent
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: large NumberFlow digits with a matching % roll from 0 to 100 in the bottom-left corner beside a thin vertical progress bar, then the cover pulls up with an arced edge. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-tiles
items.title: LoaderTiles
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a grid of square tiles (10 columns, 5 on mobile) shrinks away, rippling outward from the center. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-letters
items.title: LoaderLetters
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a word (title) rises in letter by letter, the letters lift away, then the cover pulls up. Calls onComplete when done.

items.name: loader-circle
items.title: LoaderCircle
items.description: Fullscreen intro loader: a circular hole opens at the center of the cover and widens until the whole page is revealed. Calls onComplete when done.
